sentences.l2: 周末的午后，我和朋友专程去一家颇有名气的网红店。
sentences.l1: On a weekend afternoon, a friend and I made a special trip to a fairly famous viral restaurant.

sentences.l2: 店门口的长队蜿蜒了三十多米，据店员说，平均要等上两个小时。
sentences.l1: The long queue at the entrance wound for more than thirty metres, and according to the staff, the average wait was two hours.

sentences.l2: 为了这次打卡，我们特意空腹而来，把胃留给了传闻中那道招牌甜品。
sentences.l1: For this check-in, we deliberately came on an empty stomach, saving our stomachs for the signature dessert we had heard so much about.

sentences.l2: 终于落座，环境确实精致：暖黄的灯光、复古的木桌，几乎每一个角落都像是为镜头设计的。
sentences.l1: Finally seated, we found the setting truly exquisite: warm yellow lighting, vintage wooden tables, nearly every corner seeming designed for the camera.

sentences.l2: 然而，当甜品端上来时，期待感却悄然降温——造型虽美，奶油过于甜腻，饼底也略显潮湿。
sentences.l1: However, when the dessert arrived, our expectations quietly cooled: it looked beautiful, but the cream was too sweet and cloying, and the base was a little soggy.

sentences.l2: 我们相视无言，心里都清楚，这一次恐怕是踩雷了。
sentences.l1: We looked at each other in silence, both knowing in our hearts that this time we had probably stepped on a landmine.

sentences.l2: 回家路上，我翻出手机里的点评，发现高分之下亦有微词，不少人抱怨“照骗”与性价比失衡。
sentences.l1: On the way home, I pulled up the reviews on my phone and found that beneath the high scores there were also some complaints, with quite a few people complaining about "photos that lie" and poor value for money.

sentences.l2: 或许网红店卖的从来不只是食物，更是一种值得分享的体验。
sentences.l1: Perhaps what viral restaurants sell has never been just food, but an experience worth sharing.

sentences.l2: 只是当排队的时间成本被一并计入账单，名副其实便成了一件颇为奢侈的事。
sentences.l1: But once the time cost of queuing is counted into the bill as well, living up to one's name becomes something quite luxurious.
